surcharge.label: 総コスト8＋同種の追加負荷

assumptions: D52 permits some simultaneous same-base passives while requiring a limit. The concrete policy and every number here are still trial choices.
Learning pays once per base using unchanged AH historical-cost refund. Each learned base supplies one non-saleable plain option. Extra copies or variants require distinct acquired AP possessions.
Equipment cost occupies capacity; equipping and unequipping do not spend growth points. Only selected entries contribute effects. All base types can be learned without all being equipped.

Each item has a strictly positive equipment cost calculated from authored definitions. Sale value, number of owned copies and a negative affix do not automatically create capacity or a discount. Strong forceful variants receive +1 in this first trial.
The 10-entry catalogue is four learned plain options plus six granted possessions. Identity-only swaps of equal blueprints are deduplicated when counting performance compositions.

Numeric contributions from eligible copies are summed once before the existing action resolution. Shared once-per-action pending state is updated once. Effects do not trigger additional copies recursively.
Action fixtures use frozen AM processing and AO affixes; ownership/refunds/sales use AP. No natural affix campaign, optimized strategy, user interface or human evaluation is included.
Capacity growth at milestones, diminishing effects, per-instance learning fees and simultaneous slots-plus-cost as the product default are not adopted. Old AM/AN/AO/AP artifacts remain unchanged.
